name: alfacode-team/hkm-plugin-passkeys
description: HKM Kernel plugin providing 'auth.passkeys' — native WebAuthn registration and authentication.

extra.//: No vendor WebAuthn library. The ceremonies are a CBOR decode, a COSE-to-DER conversion and two signature checks; the checks ARE the security, so they belong where the tests that pin them can be read beside them. ext-sodium is required rather than suggested: EdDSA credentials cannot be verified without it, and discovering that at the first Ed25519 sign-in is worse than at install.
